notes: SC6000 Prime is a tabletop (desktop) standalone DJ media player, not rack-mountable — rackUnits omitted. Front-panel SD card slot and rear Kensington lock slot exist but are not cable/power connectors and were omitted from the port list. Grades omitted for Link Port (Ethernet) and USB B Port because the manufacturer does not publish their exact speed. USB-A grades (5G/2.0) and mA ratings sourced from the manufacturer's spec page (denondj.com/sc6000-prime.html); all port names/locations verified against the official Denon DJ SC6000 Prime User Guide (Rear Panel and Front Panel diagrams, p.9). "Digital Outputs A/B" are S/PDIF coaxial on RCA jacks per the manual, not AES/EBU. Manufacturer brand is commonly written "Denon DJ" (a sub-brand of Denon, part of inMusic).

ports.name: Power Input
ports.note: Locking IEC inlet; included locking power cable or standard IEC cable

ports.name: Link Port
ports.note: Networks players to each other or a Denon DJ mixer; speed not stated by manufacturer

ports.name: USB B Port
ports.note: Computer MIDI I/O; USB version not stated by manufacturer

ports.name: Front USB Port
ports.note: 500 mA, USB 2.0 (per denondj.com spec page); located on front panel

ports.name: Layer A Output (L)
ports.note: Stereo analog line output, Layer A, left channel

ports.name: Layer A Output (R)
ports.note: Stereo analog line output, Layer A, right channel

ports.name: Layer B Output (L)
ports.note: Stereo analog line output, Layer B, left channel

ports.name: Layer B Output (R)
ports.note: Stereo analog line output, Layer B, right channel

ports.name: Digital Output A
ports.note: 24-bit/96kHz S/PDIF coaxial digital output on RCA jack; no bandwidth grade applies to S/PDIF coax

ports.name: Digital Output B
ports.note: 24-bit/96kHz S/PDIF coaxial digital output on RCA jack; no bandwidth grade applies to S/PDIF coax

ports.name: Remote Input
ports.note: For remote/fader-start cable to a compatible mixer; device is actually a 1/8" mono TS jack, closest available id used
